title: Slovakian Pepper Wood-Fire Roasted Vegetables
description: A hearty vegan dish featuring roasted vegetables, wood-fired for a smoky flavor.
instructions: Preheat your wood-fired grill to medium-high heat.
Toss the peppers, zucchini, onions, and potatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Grill the vegetables for 10-12 minutes per side, or until tender.
Meanwhile, roast the garlic by wrapping it in foil and heating it on the grill for 10-12 minutes.
Sauté the chopped tomatoes with roasted garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Combine the grilled vegetables and tomato mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
